answer.rationale: Finance mandates an 18% cost reduction while the incumbent refuses price concessions and the primary contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renewal. Adding the proven low-cost vendor from memory_c2 as a second source with broad allocation (~90% of volume) leverages their sharp historical cost cuts to meet the savings target, while retaining the incumbent for the remaining 10% ensures supply continuity for the 94%-utilized, zero-buffer assembly line. This dual-sourcing approach minimizes TCO through volume leverage and *reduces* delivery risk by eliminating single-point-of-failure (memory_c3), while preserving incumbent stability (memory_c1). Verifying memory_c2 confirms the vendor’s onboarding speed and cost profile are compatible with the 14-day window.
